I am Daniyal Majeed, a first‑semester B.Sc. Chemical Engineering student at UET Peshawar, Pakistan. My academic journey began with a strong foundation in mathematics and science, reflected in my 85.75% score in Matric and 71.5% in HSSC‑I. These results demonstrate my commitment to learning and my ability to handle rigorous coursework. Throughout my first semester, I have engaged with core chemical engineering concepts, oil and gas fundamentals, and practical tools such as MATLAB and AutoCAD. I have also explored creative avenues through graphic design and web development (HTML/CSS), which have sharpened my analytical and problem‑solving skills.

My career aspiration is to become a process engineer focused on designing cleaner, more efficient, and renewable energy systems—an ambition that aligns with global sustainability goals. Studying online for a Bachelors degree at a UK university through UNICAF would provide me with access to world‑class faculty, cutting‑edge research, and a flexible learning environment that accommodates my current commitments in Pakistan. The online format would allow me to apply theoretical knowledge directly to local energy challenges, fostering innovation that can be implemented back home.

I am eager to immerse myself in an international academic community, collaborate across cultures, and bring back advanced engineering practices to Pakistan’s energy sector. This scholarship represents a pivotal step toward achieving my goal of contributing to sustainable energy solutions in my country and beyond.
